regions.label: ほしぞらのていりゅうじょ
regions.kind: special (SPECIAL_REGIONS, unlocked at そだち70「たびだち」)

region_structure_notes: REGIONS = home + WORLD_MASTER.regions.normal (11 entries); SPECIAL_REGIONS (2) kept separate so region-all/partner-all conditions are not affected (script.js:9311-9333).
findRegion() looks up both lists (script.js:9391-9394); unknown ids fall back to 'home' (script.js:9401).
Special regions require hasPerk(70) to travel (script.js:19118).
home-dayparts.mjs DAYPARTS has an image set for all 13 regions x 4 dayparts (morning/day/evening/night) (home-dayparts.mjs:1-66); home-dayparts-qa.mjs:4 enumerates the same 13 ids.

dayparts.labels_source: script.js:14734 TIME_CHOICES = {auto:げんざい, morning:あさ, day:ひる, evening:ゆう, night:よる}
dayparts.decision: currentEnvironment time = NaotocchiEnvironment.timeOfDay(state.lifetime.timeMode) (script.js:14820-14821, 15468-15469). timeMode defaults to 'auto' (script.js:1566); the player can force a daypart in the せかい screen (timeModeGrid, script.js:19013-19015).
dayparts.home_render: home-production-world.mjs:16 calls dayparts.select(e.region, e.time) to crossfade the background image (home-dayparts.mjs createDayparts, presentation only).
dayparts.other_effects: Daypart also changes meguru.js lighting (e.g. meguru.js:646, 4860, 5430) and env modifiers (script.js:14737 comment: weather/time/season/region status modifiers).

music_varies_by_region_or_daypart.evidence: audio.js:263-277 currentScene() reads only state.stage (DEAD/FAREWELL), lifeCardOverlay visibility, gameActive + minigame genre, dateMovie/dateOpen, and state.isSleeping. It never reads regionId, timeOfDay, weather or season.
music_varies_by_region_or_daypart.night_track_note: The 'night' track is chosen only when state.isSleeping is true (audio.js:274), which is toggled solely by the ねる/おきる button (script.js:18617-18619). It is NOT tied to the 'night' daypart (19:00-04:59).
music_varies_by_region_or_daypart.bgm_setting: state.lifetime.soundBgm (default true, script.js:1579), toggled in the せかい screen (script.js:19043, bgmModeGrid script.js:15513).
